sentences.text: No, the documents do not state that a 5% foreclosure (pre-closure) charge may be charged on a floating-rate home loan to an individual, because for all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, with or without co-obligant(s), a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges.
The Home Loan Agreement states a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding on foreclosure or pre-payment, which is not a 5% charge.

missing.slot: whether a 5% charge is stated anywhere else in the documents
missing.searched: searched the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 and the Home Loan Agreement
